tom: Hey folks, new hire here. Trying to get dev env on my M2 Mac. asdf plugin-add python/node fails with SSL errors and the bootstrap script expects ~/.local.env which I don't have. Any quick checklist? :wave:

leila: welcome! usual checklist in order: 1) add corp root CA to system keychain, 2) install cntlm/tinyproxy if PAC/NTLM, 3) export HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY (both upper+lower), 4) ensure `eval \"$(asdf init -)\"` is early in your rc.

ben: extra tips: put `export PATH=\"$HOME/.asdf/shims:$HOME/.asdf/bin:$PATH\"` in ~/.zprofile and `eval \"$(asdf init -)\"` in ~/.zshrc so both GUI and interactive shells pick it up. If VS Code terminal shows different env, try launching VS Code from the terminal (`code .`).

tom: got the CA from IT. After adding it I still saw gpg errors when asdf-nodejs tried to verify releases.

leila: install gnupg (`brew install gnupg`) and run the plugin import script: `~/.asdf/plugins/nodejs/bin/import-release-team-keyring`. If curl can't fetch due to proxy, fix proxy first.

ben: for the missing ~/.local.env create a gitignored template: `~/.local.env.example` shows keys to add. We use 1Password: `eval $(op signin)` then `op item get \"redwood/dev-tokens\" --fields NPM_TOKEN > ~/.local.env` (only do this locally). Use direnv to load it safely: `.envrc` with `source_env ~/.local.env` then `direnv allow`.

tom: thanks. Any quick smoke commands to validate?

leila: try this sequence: ```sh
# start local proxy if needed
brew services start cntlm
# export proxies
export HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:3128
export HTTPS_PROXY=$HTTP_PROXY
# verify git over proxy
git -c http.proxy=$HTTP_PROXY ls-remote https://github.com/asdf-vm/asdf.git
# test asdf plugin add
asdf plugin-add nodejs https://github.com/asdf-vm/asdf-nodejs.git && asdf install nodejs latest
# check shims
which node
node -v
```

ben: and if `which node` points at brew or system, run `brew unlink node` and reopen the shell. Also `asdf reshim` after installs.

infra-bot: Note: onboarding KB updated with \"mac arm asdf & proxy\" steps: https://internal.redwood/docs/onboarding/mac-arm-asdf-proxy.

tom: nailed it — CA + cntlm fixed the downloads and the plugin import cleared gpg errors. direnv + local.env made token handling easy. thanks everyone! :tada:
